entries.en: [original defective; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 仅存汉字「結究」；西语词头空缺、闽南与官话两栏皆残，「究」疑为「仇」之形近讹字，无法定夺。

entries.zh: 结怨，结下仇怨（仅存汉字栏，释义存疑）
entries.en: to incur enmity, to contract a grudge (Chinese column only)
entries.notes: 西语词头空缺，闽南、官话两栏皆残，释义仅据汉字「結怨」推得。

entries.zh: 招祸，结下祸患（仅存汉字栏，释义存疑）
entries.en: to bring disaster upon oneself, to court calamity (Chinese column only)
entries.notes: 西语词头空缺，闽南、官话两栏皆残，释义仅据汉字「結禍」推得。

entries.en: to amend, to correct; to untie, to undo

entries.zh: 改过自新，修正自己的生活
entries.en: to amend one's life, to reform one's ways

entries.zh: 修身，修养自身德行（改过迁善）
entries.en: to cultivate oneself morally; to amend one's life

entries.zh: 改过自新（原件汉字作「脩蹄」，音写指向「修腳」，与西语词头不合，存疑）
entries.en: to amend one's life (Chinese column reads 'xiu jiao/ti', apparently mismatched)
entries.notes: 四栏不合：M「siú ca」、R「siñ quio」均指「修腳」，与 enmendar la vida 不相应，疑原件误置或字有讹。

entries.zh: 修行，修养品行（道德或宗教上的修持）
entries.en: to cultivate oneself; to practise moral or religious discipline

entries.zh: 修养廉正（疑；原字「欽」与音写不合）
entries.en: to cultivate integrity (probable; Chinese character uncertain)
entries.notes: 第二字作「欽」而 M「liàm」、R「liōn」皆指向「廉」，且「修廉」非常语，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 克制自己，约束自身（改正己过）
entries.en: to restrain oneself, to exercise self-control; to correct oneself
to discipline, to punish (so as to correct)
to emend a text, to revise by adding and correcting
entries.notes: M 栏作「解」（queỳ）、R 栏作「改」（guiaŷ），二字形近，从词头义定为「增改」。

entries.en: to transcribe, to make a fair copy
entries.notes: 汉字疑「謄/騰」，而 M「siēn sià」近「繕寫」、R「teng siè」近「謄寫」，二字同义而并存。

entries.en: anger, annoyance; resentment; to be vexed
anger, wrath
to threaten, to frighten; to rage at
entries.notes: 「嚇」本义恐吓，词头作 enojo，取发怒而威吓之意。

entries.en: angry, resentful; resentment
entries.notes: 汉字疑「悻/恆」，R 栏「hāng」与「悻」音不合，姑从「悻」。

entries.en: anger, indignation (character probably 恚, 'resentment')
entries.notes: 若作「恬」则义为安静，与 enojo 相反；而 M/R 音值（quieñ/quīe）与「恬」「恚」均不尽合，释义存疑。

entries.en: hatred, resentment; to resent
to be angry; resentment, indignation
[original defective; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 汉字与官话栏皆空、闽南栏两音均污损；词头「en arbor paras」疑为 enarborar（升起、张挂）之讹，未能定夺。
